shared_elements: horizontal band/frieze of repeated motifs running along a low horizontal surface
row of rounded, roughly quadruped-like forms repeated in a line
decoration confined to the upper portion of a block/wall face
possible register division (upper row over a lower zone)
justification: Both surfaces carry a linear frieze of repeated, rounded, animal-like forms marching horizontally along the upper part of a long low face, which gives a comparable overall reading as a processional band. But B shows clearly articulated creatures in profile with legs and heads, organised into two registers separated by a hatched/netted band, while A's motifs are amorphous rounded blotches with no discernible limbs, heads, orientation or second register, so the correspondence stays at the generic level of "a row of shapes".
